name: Kougami Nachi
source:
One of your childhood friends. High school senior.
He has grown up with you and Subaru since he was a child and both of you are like older siblings to him. He’s often seen as free-spirited and self-centred, but he treats everyone equally and has many friends. Good at sports and a member of the high school football club as well as the photography club.

‘There’s nothing for you to worry about. You have me right here, after all.’

[Translated from [url=https://animal-pla.net/hoshikuzu/]the official website[/url].]
